title: Your Rim Light Isn't Weak — Your Fill Is Just Winning
excerpt: Lighting educator Karl Taylor shows why two studio lights pull against each other in a high-key portrait, and the stop-by-stop method for balancing rim and fill.

title: Nikon's Z5IIC Drops the Viewfinder — Should You?
excerpt: Nikon just cut the electronic viewfinder out of its cheapest full-frame camera and called it the Z5IIC. Here is what is gone, what survived, and whether the savings are worth it.

title: The Fastest Tilt-Shift Ever Is a 24mm f/2 From Laowa
